title: Maximum Average Subarray I
description:
Find the k numbers in a row with the largest average, and return that average. Answers within 0.00001 are accepted.

nums = [1, 12, -5, -6, 50, 3], k = 4 → 12.75 (12 - 5 - 6 + 50 = 51, and 51 / 4 = 12.75)
tracePrompt: Trace of [1, 12, -5, -6, 50, 3], k = 4: one row per full window
